comparator.name: Scandinavian Languages and Cultures (Scandinavia Studies)
comparator.sourceNotes: The retained Danish main-language route closes 60+60+60. It includes the required selected 30-EC abroad block, Danish translation, a 12-EC graduation project and 30 EC of genuine free profiling. A home alternative requires examination-board approval and is not stacked. Diagnostic and tutoring formation are zero-credit. Current evidence supports Dutch and Danish instruction; receptive Norwegian and Swedish study is not treated as programme-wide teaching-medium evidence.
